verdict.rationale: Checkout.com's first-party Platforms solution explicitly covers all three elements of the story: onboarding sub-entities for marketplaces and Payfacs, splitting funds between the platform and sub-entities, and paying out to sub-entities in their local currency and preferred method. Supporting docs include idempotent /transfers, a payouts reconciliation report suite and bank payouts testing. missing for 10: detailed docs on onboarding/KYC flows and split-payment API mechanics (only overview-level statements), independent or hands-on corroboration of the Platforms product.
